meaning: Excuse me / Sorry / Feeling embarrassed
note: Lighter than 对不起 (I'm sorry). Used when bumping into someone, asking a favor, or feeling grateful/shy.
example_hz: 不好意思借过一下，我赶时间。
example_py: Bù hǎoyìsi jièguò yīxià, wǒ gǎn shíjiān.
example_en: Excuse me, coming through, I'm in a rush.

meaning: Almost / roughly / more or less / close enough
note: Famous cultural concept in Chinese life: things don't need to be 100% exact, 'close enough' is fine.
example_hz: 时间差不多了，我们准备出发吧。
example_py: Shíjiān chàbuduō le, wǒmen zhǔnbèi chūfā ba.
example_en: Time is pretty much up, let's get ready to head out.

meaning: Whatever / Up to you / Anything is fine
note: The most common response in Chinese when asked what to eat or do. Can be neutral or dismissive depending on tone.
example_hz: 中午去哪儿吃？——随便，我都行。
example_py: Zhōngwǔ qù nǎr chī? —— Suíbiàn, wǒ dōu xíng.
example_en: Where to eat for lunch? —— Whatever, anything works for me.

meaning: Forget it / Drop it / Let it go
note: Used to concede, stop an argument, or give up on an idea.
example_hz: 算了吧，别再跟他争了，没意思。
example_py: Suànle ba, bié zài gēn tā zhēng le, méi yìsi.
example_en: Forget it, don't argue with him anymore, it's pointless.

meaning: What are you doing? / Why? / What for?
note: Informal contraction of 干什么. Can sound playful, defensive, or curious.
example_hz: 你干嘛这样看着我？我脸上有东西吗？
example_py: Nǐ gànmá zhèyàng kàn zhe wǒ? Wǒ liǎn shang yǒu dōngxi ma?
example_en: Why are you looking at me like that? Is there something on my face?

meaning: Really?! / Are you serious?! / For real?
note: Everyday conversational exclamation when hearing surprising gossip or news.
example_hz: 真的假的？他居然把老板给炒了？
example_py: Zhēn de jiǎ de? Tā jīurán bǎ lǎobǎn gěi chǎo le?
example_en: For real?! He actually fired his boss?!

meaning: Awkward / cringey / embarrassing
note: Describes social awkwardness, second-hand embarrassment, or uncomfortable situations.
example_hz: 刚才打招呼认错人了，场面极度尴尬。
example_py: Gāngcái dǎ zhāohu rèncuò rén le, chǎngmiàn jídù gāngà.
example_en: I just waved at the wrong person, the situation was insanely awkward.

meaning: Cup / glass / mug
note: Basic household object missing from the original deck.
example_hz: 请帮我倒一杯水，杯子在桌子上。
example_py: Qǐng bāng wǒ dào yī bēi shuǐ, bēizi zài zhuōzi shang.
example_en: Please help me pour a glass of water, the cup is on the table.

meaning: Instant noodles / ramen
note: 泡面 (pàomiàn) is the colloquial term for noodles brewed with boiling water.
example_hz: 大半夜饿了，煮一碗方便面加个蛋最舒服。
example_py: Dà bànyè è le, zhǔ yī wǎn fāngbiànmiàn jiā gè dàn zuì shūfu.
example_en: Hungry in the middle of the night, cooking a bowl of instant noodles with an egg hits the spot.

meaning: Tomato
note: 北方 (North China) commonly says 西红柿, while 南方 (South) often says 番茄.
example_hz: 西红柿炒鸡蛋是每个中国人都会做的家常菜。
example_py: Xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn shì měi gè zhōngguórén dōu huì zuò de jiāchángcài.
example_en: Tomato scrambled eggs is a home-style dish that every Chinese person knows how to make.

meaning: Banana
note: Common fruit missing from the original sentence deck.
example_hz: 去超市买一把香蕉和几个苹果。
example_py: Qù chāoshì mǎi yī bǎ xiāngjiāo hé jǐ gè píngguǒ.
example_en: Go to the supermarket to buy a bunch of bananas and a few apples.

meaning: To see a doctor / to seek medical care
note: Used both for the patient 'seeing a doctor' and the doctor 'treating patients'.
example_hz: 他发烧两天了，今天必须去医院看病。
example_py: Tā fāshāo liǎng tiān le, jīntiān bìxū qù yīyuàn kànbìng.
example_en: He's had a fever for two days, he must go to the hospital to see a doctor today.

meaning: To have a holiday / to have days off
note: Notice the 4th tone on 假 (jià = holiday, distinct from jiǎ = fake).
example_hz: 下周我们放假三天，你有什么打算？
example_py: Xià zhōu wǒmen fàngjià sān tiān, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
example_en: We have three days off next week, do you have any plans?

meaning: To work overtime
note: Unavoidable topic in Chinese professional life.
example_hz: 今天又要加班，可能赶不上最后一班地铁了。
example_py: Jīntiān yòu yào jiābān, kěnéng gǎnbushàng zuìhòu yī bān dìtiě le.
example_en: Working overtime again today, might not catch the last subway train.

meaning: Check please! / To pay the bill
note: What you yell to the restaurant staff when ready to pay.
example_hz: 服务员，买单！打包这两个菜。
example_py: Fúwùyuán, mǎidān! Dǎbāo zhè liǎng gè cài.
example_en: Waiter, bill please! And pack up these two dishes.

meaning: To scroll on phone / doomscroll
note: 刷 literally means to brush/swipe. Describes endlessly flicking through TikTok, Xiaohongshu, or social media.
example_hz: 别整天在床上刷手机了，出去晒晒太阳。
example_py: Bié zhěngtiān zài chuáng shang shuā shǒujī le, chūqù shàishài tàiyáng.
example_en: Stop doomscrolling in bed all day, go outside and get some sun.

meaning: To give a 'like' / thumbs up
note: Used on all Chinese social apps, and also figuratively in speech for 'giving props' to someone.
example_hz: 要是觉得有用，别忘了点个赞！
example_py: Yàoshi juéde yǒuyòng, bié wàng le diǎn gè zàn!
example_en: If you found this helpful, don't forget to leave a like!

meaning: To work for a boss / wage labor
note: Origin of the viral meme '打工人' (working-class laborer striving every day).
example_hz: 加油打工人！今天又是元气满满的一天。
example_py: Jiāyóu dǎgōngrén! Jīntiān yòu shì yuánqì mǎnmǎn de yī tiān.
example_en: Keep pushing, wage worker! Another day full of energy.

meaning: Lying flat / opting out of the rat race
note: Major youth culture term for rejecting extreme hustle culture and doing the bare minimum.
example_hz: 这周工作太累了，周末我只想躺平不看任何消息。
example_py: Zhè zhōu gōngzuò tài lèi le, zhōumò wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tǎngpíng bù kàn rènhé xiāoxi.
example_en: Work was too tiring this week, on the weekend I just want to lie flat and ignore all messages.

meaning: Hyper-competitive rat race / involution
note: When competition becomes so fierce that everyone works harder just to stay in the same place.
example_hz: 现在的行业内卷太严重了，大家天天加班。
example_py: Xiànzài de hángyè nèijuǎn tài yánzhòng le, dàjiā tiāntiān jiābān.
example_en: The rat race in this industry is too intense now, everyone works overtime every day.

meaning: To vent / roast / complain / air grievances
note: Originally from Japanese manzai comedy (tsukkomi), now ubiquitous in Chinese for witty complaining or roasting.
example_hz: 我想吐槽一下昨天的电影，真的太难看了。
example_py: Wǒ xiǎng tùcáo yīxià zuótiān de diànyǐng, zhēn de tài nánkàn le.
example_en: I need to vent about yesterday's movie, it was truly horrible.

meaning: What the hell? / What are you doing?
note: Expresses annoyance when someone does something confusing, slow, or frustrating.
example_hz: 搞毛啊，怎么还没来？
example_py: Gǎo máo a, zěnme hái méi lái?
example_en: What the hell, why haven't they arrived yet?

meaning: No way / Not a chance! / Forget about it
note: Direct, informal way to reject an impossible or ridiculous request.
example_hz: 借钱给你？没门儿！
example_py: Jiè qián gěi nǐ? Méiménr!
example_en: Lend you money? Not a chance!

meaning: Tired as a dog / dog-tired / exhausted
note: Vivid Chinese idiom used when completely worn out after a long day.
example_hz: 搬了一整天家，现在真是累成狗了。
example_py: Bān le yī zhěng tiān jiā, xiànzài zhēn shì lèi chéng gǒu le.
example_en: Moved houses all day long, right now I am honestly tired as a dog.

meaning: Holy shit! / WTF! / No way!
note: Euphemistic substitute for 我操 (wǒ cào). Note: 槽 is 2nd tone (cáo = trough/manger), but people often say it like 4th tone 操 (cào = the crude original). 卧槽 is the written internet version used to dodge censorship. The raw version 操 (cào) is 4th tone — you were right! Multi-purpose exclamation for shock, disbelief, admiration, or frustration.
example_hz: 卧槽，这也太酷了吧！
example_py: Wòcáo, zhè yě tài kù le ba!
example_en: Holy shit, this is way too cool!

meaning: Badass / awesome / insane skill
note: Universal praise for someone who does something extraordinarily well or impressive.
example_hz: 哥们儿，你这也太牛逼了！
example_py: Gēmenr, nǐ zhè yě tài niúbī le!
example_en: Bro, you are seriously freaking awesome!

meaning: Reliable / trustworthy / solid
note: Extremely common in daily life and business. Opposite is 不靠谱 (shady / flaky).
example_hz: 找他帮忙肯定没问题，这人办事很靠谱。
example_py: Zhǎo tā bāngmáng kěndìng méi wèntí, zhè rén bànshì hěn kàopǔ.
example_en: Asking him for help won't be a problem, he is very reliable.

meaning: Speechless / rolling my eyes
note: When something is so absurd, stupid, or ridiculous that you have no words to describe it.
example_hz: 看了这个新闻，我真是一整个无语。
example_py: Kàn le zhège xīnwén, wǒ zhēn shì yī zhěng gè wúyǔ.
example_en: After seeing this news, I am honestly completely speechless.

meaning: WeChat (the app for everything in China)
note: China's operating system for daily life: messaging, payments, restaurant ordering, taxis.
example_hz: 加个微信吧，回头发定位给你。
example_py: Jiā gè wēixìn ba, huítóu fā dìngwèi gěi nǐ.
example_en: Let's add WeChat, I'll send you the location pin later.

meaning: Food delivery / takeout
note: Ordering via Meituan or Ele.me is a cornerstone of daily life in China.
example_hz: 今晚太累不想做饭，叫外卖吧。
example_py: Jīnwǎn tài lèi bù xiǎng zuòfàn, jiào wàimài ba.
example_en: Too tired to cook tonight, let's just order delivery.

meaning: To hail a taxi / order a ride (Didi)
note: 打 (dǎ) is used idiomatically for calling/hailing transport.
example_hz: 外面雨下得太大了，我们打车走吧。
example_py: Wàimiàn yǔ xià de tài dà le, wǒmen dǎchē zǒu ba.
example_en: The rain outside is pouring, let's call a taxi.

meaning: Scan QR code (to pay, order, unlock bike, etc.)
note: Indispensable in daily life in China: used for buying groceries, taking the subway, ordering at restaurants, and adding contacts.
example_hz: 请扫码点餐，或者扫码付款都可以。
example_py: Qǐng sǎomǎ diǎncān, huòzhě sǎomǎ fùkuǎn dōu kěyǐ.
example_en: Please scan the QR code to order, or scan to pay.

meaning: Power bank / portable phone charger
note: Shared power bank rental stations (共享充电宝) are ubiquitous across malls, restaurants, and convenience stores in China.
example_hz: 我手机快没电了，附近有借充电宝的地方吗？
example_py: Wǒ shǒujī kuài méi diàn le, fùjìn yǒu jiè chōngdiànbǎo de dìfang ma?
example_en: My phone is almost dead, is there a place nearby to rent a power bank?

meaning: Alipay (mobile payment and digital lifestyle platform)
note: Together with WeChat Pay (微信支付), the primary payment method across all of China.
example_hz: 老板，支持微信还是支付宝？——两个都可以扫。
example_py: Lǎobǎn, zhīchí Wēixìn háishi Zhīfùbǎo? —— Liǎng gè dōu kěyǐ sǎo.
example_en: Boss, do you take WeChat or Alipay? —— Both work, just scan.

meaning: GPS navigation / Navigate / Map app
note: Used as both noun and verb: '开个导航' means 'turn on the GPS navigation app'.
example_hz: 我不认识路，先把导航打开吧。
example_py: Wǒ bù rènshi lù, xiān bǎ dǎoháng dǎkāi ba.
example_en: I don't know the way, let's open the GPS navigation first.

meaning: Express delivery / Parcel / Package
note: '拿快递' (pick up the delivery parcel) is an almost daily ritual for residents receiving packages at locker stations.
example_hz: 下楼顺便帮我拿个快递好吗？在菜鸟驿站。
example_py: Xià lóu shùnbiàn bāng wǒ ná ge kuàidì hǎo ma? Zài Càiniǎo yìzhàn.
example_en: Could you pick up a package for me when you head downstairs? It's at the pickup station.

meaning: Conveniently / On the way / By the way
note: Extremely frequent in everyday conversational requests: doing something extra because it's conveniently along the path.
example_hz: 你去超市吗？顺便帮我买瓶牛奶吧。
example_py: Nǐ qù chāoshì ma? Shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi píng niúnǎi ba.
example_en: Are you going to the supermarket? Could you grab a bottle of milk for me while you're at it?

meaning: Pretty / Quite / Rather (colloquial intensifier)
note: Very common in spoken Mandarin (especially central and southern China): '蛮好' (pretty good), '蛮贵' (pretty expensive).
example_hz: 这家餐馆味道蛮不错的，价格也蛮便宜。
example_py: Zhè jiā cānguǎn wèidao mán bùcuò de, jiàgé yě mán piányi.
example_en: The food at this restaurant is pretty good, and the prices are quite reasonable.

meaning: Wow! / Holy cow! / Incredible!
note: High-frequency spoken exclamation of genuine awe, astonishment, or delight.
example_hz: 哇塞，这栋大楼也太壮观了吧！
example_py: Wāsài, zhè dòng dàlóu yě tài zhuàngguān le ba!
example_en: Wow, this skyscraper is magnificent!

meaning: Slacking off at work / Loafing during office hours
note: Derived from the idiom 混水摸鱼; universally used by modern office workers for browsing online or chatting on the clock.
example_hz: 老板不在办公室，大家都在偷偷摸鱼。
example_py: Lǎobǎn bù zài bàngōngshì, dàjiā dōu zài tōutōu mōyú.
example_en: The boss isn't in the office, so everyone is secretly slacking off.

meaning: Social death / Dying of immense public embarrassment
note: Abbreviation of 社会性死亡: an excruciatingly awkward moment in public where you just want the ground to swallow you.
example_hz: 在公共场合把手机外放音乐了，当场社死！
example_py: Zài gōnggòng chǎnghé bǎ shǒujī wàifàng yīnyuè le, dāngchǎng shèsǐ!
example_en: My phone blasted loud music by accident in public, absolute social death on the spot!

meaning: Humblebrag / Flexing while pretending to complain
note: Named after the Palace of Versailles: complaining about something to subtly brag about luxury, wealth, or high status.
example_hz: 他说住三层的别墅每天上下楼太累了，这也太凡尔赛了吧！
example_py: Tā shuō zhù sān céng de biéshù měitiān shàngxià lóu tài lèi le, zhè yě tài fán'ěrsài le ba!
example_en: He said walking up and down his 3-story villa is too exhausting—what a massive humblebrag!

meaning: Painfully relatable / Hitting a raw nerve / Heartbreaking
note: Popularized by the viral internet phrase '扎心了，老铁' (That cuts deep, buddy).
example_hz: 你这句话太扎心了，能不能别提我单身的事？
example_py: Nǐ zhè jù huà tài zhāxīn le, néng bu néng bié tí wǒ dānshēn de shì?
example_en: That remark cut right to the bone, can you not bring up that I'm single?

meaning: Watching drama / Gossiping as a bystander
note: '吃瓜群众' (melon-seed eating spectators): bystanders casually watching celebrities or colleagues drama unfold.
example_hz: 微博上又有人爆大料了，快来一起吃瓜！
example_py: Wēibó shang yòu yǒurén bào dà liào le, kuài lái yīqǐ chīguā!
example_en: Someone dropped massive tea on Weibo again, come grab some popcorn and watch the drama!

meaning: To hype up / recommend a product so someone craves it
note: Literally 'planting grass': getting someone hooked on wanting to buy a gadget, cosmetic, or travel destination.
example_hz: 看完她的测评视频，我立刻被种草了这台相机。
example_py: Kàn wán tā de cèpíng shìpín, wǒ lìkè bèi zhòngcǎo le zhè tái xiàngjī.
example_en: After watching her review video, I was instantly hyped to buy this camera.

meaning: Finally buying something you craved, or giving up on it
note: Opposite of 种草: either satisfying the urge by purchasing it, or ditching the desire after seeing bad reviews.
example_hz: 心心念念那家咖啡厅很久了，今天终于去拔草了。
example_py: Xīnxīn niànniàn nà jiā kāfēitīng hěn jiǔ le, jīntiān zhōngyú qù bácǎo le.
example_en: I've been longing to visit that coffee shop for ages, and today I finally went and checked it off my wishlist.

meaning: Defensive walls broken / Emotionally touched or overwhelmed
note: Originally from gaming (guard broken). Now used when an emotional scene or hurtful truth hits you so hard you break down crying.
example_hz: 看到电影结尾那封信，我彻底破防了，眼泪停不下来。
example_py: Kàndào diànyǐng jiéwěi nà fēng xìn, wǒ chèdǐ pòfáng le, yǎnlèi tíng bu xiàlai.
example_en: Seeing that letter at the end of the movie completely broke me, I couldn't stop crying.

meaning: I'm speechless / You've got to be kidding me
note: Exclamation of exasperation or amused bewilderment when encountering something absurd or facepalm-worthy.
example_hz: 排了两个小时队居然卖完了，我也是醉了！
example_py: Pái le liǎng gè xiǎoshí duì jūrán mài wán le, wǒ yě shì zuì le!
example_en: Queued up for two whole hours only for it to be sold out, I'm completely speechless!

meaning: Handle it / Taken care of / Set it up!
note: In modern colloquial slang, '安排一下' or '安排妥了' means 'we've got it handled, it's taken care of'.
example_hz: 放心吧兄弟，今晚的聚餐我都给你安排妥了！
example_py: Fàngxīn ba xiōngdì, jīnwǎn de jùcān wǒ dōu gěi nǐ ānpái tuǒ le!
example_en: Don't worry bro, I've got tonight's dinner party completely taken care of for you!

meaning: Shopping spree frenzy / Regretting buying too much online
note: Humorous vow to 'chop off one's hands' so one stops clicking 'Buy Now' during Double 11 sales.
example_hz: 双十一又买了一堆没用的东西，真想剁手！
example_py: Shuāng shíyī yòu mǎi le yī duī méiyòng de dōngxi, zhēn xiǎng duòshǒu!
example_en: I bought a mountain of useless stuff on Singles Day again, I swear I need to chop my hands off!

meaning: Down-to-earth / Relatable / In touch with ordinary people
note: Praising a celebrity, policy, or dish for being humble, accessible, and connected to real everyday life.
example_hz: 这个明星一点架子都没有，说话特别接地气。
example_py: Zhè ge míngxīng yīdiǎn jiàzi dōu méiyǒu, shuōhuà tèbié jiēdìqì.
example_en: This celebrity puts on zero airs; the way she talks is super down-to-earth.

meaning: Traffic jam / Gridlock
note: Everyday essential word in every Chinese city, especially during morning and evening rush hour (早晚高峰).
example_hz: 早高峰路上堵车特别严重，我可能会迟到十分钟。
example_py: Zǎo gāofēng lù shang dǔchē tèbié yánzhòng, wǒ kěnéng huì chídào shí fēnzhōng.
example_en: The morning rush hour traffic is completely jammed, I might be ten minutes late.

meaning: Pull over to the curb / Stop on the side
note: The universal phrase spoken to taxi or Didi drivers when you arrive at your destination.
example_hz: 师傅，就在前面路口靠边停一下，谢谢！
example_py: Shīfu, jiù zài qiánmian lùkǒu kàobiān tíng yīxià, xièxie!
example_en: Driver, please just pull over by the intersection up ahead, thank you!

meaning: Settle the bill / Pay the tab
note: The standard neutral term alongside 买单 used when calling the server over at the end of a meal.
example_hz: 服务员，我们吃好了，麻烦结一下账。
example_py: Fúwùyuán, wǒmen chī hǎo le, máfan jié yīxià zhàng.
example_en: Waiter, we're all done eating, could we please settle the bill?

meaning: Scrolling short videos (Douyin, TikTok, Kuaishou)
note: '刷' (swiping/brushing) is the universal verb for scrolling feeds (刷手机, 刷微博, 刷视频).
example_hz: 晚上躺在床上刷视频，一不小心就到了半夜一点。
example_py: Wǎnshang tǎng zài chuáng shang shuā shìpín, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù dào le bànyè yī diǎn.
example_en: Lying in bed scrolling short videos at night, before I knew it, it was 1 AM.

meaning: Freeloading a meal / Crashing a dinner
note: '蹭' means getting a free ride or freebie out of someone else's resources (蹭车 carpool, 蹭wifi piggybacking wifi).
example_hz: 今天不想做饭了，去你家蹭顿饭行不行？
example_py: Jīntiān bù xiǎng zuòfàn le, qù nǐ jiā cèng dùn fàn xíng bu xíng?
example_en: I don't feel like cooking today, can I crash at your place for dinner?
